# Fixture Licenses

All stage 1 parser fixtures are generated during tests from short text written specifically for this project. They contain no third-party book or voice content and are released under the repository license.

Stage 0 local Qwen tests use a temporary macOS system-generated Chinese reference under `.local/benchmark/`. It is not committed or uploaded. Release protocol tests will use a generated sine-wave audio file and synthetic metadata, which are created by the test and contain no third-party content.
